init.title: Power Management
init.description: Choose which optional segments to enable below. Solar PV Plant itself is always included.

data_description.ev_charging: Manage EV charger scheduling and load control, e.g. charging on solar surplus or off-peak spot prices.
data_description.pool: Manage pool pump/heater scheduling, e.g. running the pump during solar surplus hours.
data_description.pv_surplus: Manage what happens to solar production left over once the battery and other loads are covered.

pv_inverter.title: Solar PV Plant
pv_inverter.description: Which inverter do you have? Picking one lets PwMngt auto-fill several of the next page's fields for you.

solar_pv_plant.title: Solar PV Plant
solar_pv_plant.description: Pick the entity in your own Home Assistant that PwMngt should mirror for each value below.{auto_filled_note}

data_description.battery_soc: The entity that reports your home battery's state of charge (%), e.g. your inverter's battery SoC sensor. Only "%"-unit sensors are listed.
data_description.battery_pv_charged: The entity that reports total energy charged into the battery (kWh) from your solar plant, e.g. from your inverter. Only "kWh"-unit sensors are listed.
data_description.battery_pv_discharged: The entity that reports total energy discharged from the battery (kWh). Only "kWh"-unit sensors are listed.
data_description.battery_power: The entity that reports the battery's current charge/discharge power (W). Only "W"-unit sensors are listed.
data_description.battery_grid_charged_day: The entity that reports how much energy has been charged into the battery from the grid today (kWh) -- a daily counter that resets at midnight, e.g. your inverter's own "charge from grid today" sensor. Only "kWh"-unit sensors are listed. Pre-filled automatically from your inverter if it's a supported brand. Used to tell grid-charged battery content from PV-charged.

data_description.pv1_power: The entity that reports PV string 1's current power output (W). Only "W"-unit sensors are listed.
data_description.pv2_power: The entity that reports PV string 2's current power output (W). Only "W"-unit sensors are listed. Optional -- leave empty if you don't have a second PV string.
data_description.pv3_power: The entity that reports PV string 3's current power output (W). Only "W"-unit sensors are listed. Optional -- leave empty if you don't have a third PV string.

data_description.grid_power: The entity that reports current power flow to/from the grid (W). Only "W"-unit sensors are listed.
data_description.pv_direct_consumption: The entity that reports power currently consumed directly from PV production (W), without going through the battery. Only "W"-unit sensors are listed.
data_description.pv_total_consumption: The entity that reports total cumulative PV consumption (kWh). Only "kWh"-unit sensors are listed.
data_description.property_consumption_total: The entity that reports the whole property's cumulative energy consumption (kWh) as a raw, ever-increasing lifetime counter -- e.g. your inverter's own lifetime consumption sensor. Only "kWh"-unit sensors are listed. Pre-filled automatically from your inverter if it's a supported brand -- pick a different entity if you don't want that. Do not point this at a Daily Utility Meter helper -- PwMngt tracks its own local-midnight reset internally, so it needs the raw, never-resetting counter instead.

data_description.pv_forecast_today: The entity that reports today's forecasted PV production for the whole plant (kWh), e.g. from a solar forecast integration. Only "kWh"-unit sensors are listed. Pre-filled automatically if Solcast PV Forecast is installed and unambiguous -- pick a different entity if you don't want that.
data_description.pv_forecast_tomorrow: The entity that reports tomorrow's forecasted PV production for the whole plant (kWh), e.g. from a solar forecast integration. Only "kWh"-unit sensors are listed. Pre-filled automatically if Solcast PV Forecast is installed and unambiguous -- pick a different entity if you don't want that.

data_description.spot_electricity_price: The entity that reports the current spot electricity price (kr/kWh), e.g. from the Strømligning integration. Only "kr/kWh"-unit sensors are listed.

missing_solcast_solar.title: Solcast PV Forecast is not installed
missing_solcast_solar.description:
PwMngt's "PV forecast today" and "PV forecast tomorrow" fields (Options -> Solar PV Plant) expect a whole-plant solar forecast sensor (kWh), which normally comes from the **Solcast PV Forecast** integration. Without it there's nothing to pick for those two required fields, and the Solar PV Plant wizard can't be completed.

Install and set up Solcast PV Forecast (via HACS, or search for it directly in Settings -> Devices & services -> Add integration), then revisit PwMngt's options to pick its forecast sensor. This warning clears itself automatically once Solcast PV Forecast is installed.

missing_stromligning.title: Strømligning is not installed
missing_stromligning.description:
PwMngt's "Spot electricity price" field (Options -> Solar PV Plant) expects a spot-price sensor (kr/kWh), which normally comes from the **Strømligning** integration. Without it there's nothing to pick for this required field, and the Solar PV Plant wizard can't be completed.

Install and set up Strømligning (via HACS, or search for it directly in Settings -> Devices & services -> Add integration), then revisit PwMngt's options to pick its price sensor. This warning clears itself automatically once Strømligning is installed.
